candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: As another possible back-end feature, could we have an interactive gallery that viewers are able to scroll through?

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text:
Thanks so much for explaining. All of our services are itemized, and customers can qualify for a bundle as they select more services. The calculator would therefore need to recognize whether their selections meet the rules for a bundle; if they do not, it should simply add the individual service prices together. I picture it as a survey, potentially beginning like this:

Photos (yes/no)

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text:
Thank you for the clarification. Because all our services are itemized, selecting more of them can qualify a customer for a bundle. The calculator must determine whether the chosen services meet a bundle rule; otherwise, it should add the individual prices. I imagine a survey along these lines:

How many sqft is the property?
- under 1200: pricing tier 1
- 1201 - 2400: pricing tier 2
- 2401 - 3600: pricing tier 3
- 2401 - 3600: pricing tier 4
- 3601 +: pricing tier 5
(*An answer of 1840 sqft is assigned to pricing tier 2*)

Photos (yes/no): Yes = +320; No = +0.00 (*answers yes*)
Videos? (yes/no): Yes = +280; No = +0.00 (*answers yes*)
What is the address? The calculator determines the distance from the home office. If it is over 35 miles, apply a $90 surcharge. (*The submitted address is 42 miles away: +90*)
(*The selections qualify for the basic bundle: -$140*)
(*Presses submit*)
*Displays total: $550*

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: The work looks great so far, and Option 2 is closer to the direction we want. Since we have 4 bundles, could the pricing section contain 4 boxes? On the home screen, please reduce the amount of blue so the image receives more emphasis, while still retaining a little blue. Could you also give the homepage gallery some basic animation? Finally, please add a button or section in the pricing area that leads visitors to more detailed pricing information. Thank you!

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: Thanks so much. For now, I would like to defer the instant quote form. When the time is right to develop it, I will reach out again.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: The homepage looks good overall. The only remaining change is to restore the home-screen image overlay to blue while reducing its opacity, leaving just a small blue highlight over the image. Once that is done, the homepage should be ready.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text:
The homepage looks great, and I also like the current gallery design. For the services page, could each listed service have a corresponding image—for example, photos, twilights, floor plans, and 3D views? Because this is primarily a photography business, every page should be highly visual and image-focused.

Please remove the monthly and annual tabs from the services page because all pricing is one-time only. For the bundles, could we have four spaces instead of 3? I would also like a large diagram showing every individual service we offer. Full pricing transparency is important so customers can see the exact breakdown and add individual items when needed. I have attached a PDF containing all items that must be included; most are categorized by both price and property square footage.

The main gallery only needs tabs for photos, twilights, videos, floor plans, and 3d tour. A smaller area could cover other photography since we sometimes accept one-off clients. During development of the actual website, could the gallery items also receive hover animations? Overall, the pages look excellent!

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: The prototype looks excellent and is nearly perfect. One final revision is needed on the pricing page: could the package and bundle prices be updated so they accurately vary according to property square footage?

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: We should use predefined pricing rather than a calculator: the display will show 4 packages with 4 prices. I will provide the required rates. The pricing categories are under 1200sqft, 1201-2400 sqft, 2401-3600 sqft, and 3600\+ sqft.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: Yes, sir. Much appreciated.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: For the domain and hosting provider, I am using name cheap. The site uses word press, managed through c panel.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text:
A few items came up, although the site is looking great overall. I think the gallery may have a glitch, and I’ve recorded the following clip to demonstrate it.

Could we disable hover animations on the mobile version? Because touching the screen is the only way to trigger a hover there, the effect can feel a bit jarring.

If feasible, it would also be great to reformat the mobile pricing sheet so all the information is visible without scrolling to the right. I understand that this may be too late because implementation of the site has already begun.

Finally, could the home-screen buttons link directly to their corresponding Gallery, Pricing, and Services pages? At present, they appear to send users back to the top of the home page.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text:
Let’s leave both items as they are for now: the animations are great, and the current pricing approach works well. I’ll brainstorm the pricing layout further and update you if my preference changes.

While I’m pulling photos from my portfolio, how many will I need to send for the gallery to be set up properly?

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: Please use your judgment and choose whichever photos and placements fit best; I don’t have a strong preference.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: The website looks great overall! I only found a few remaining items: could the portfolio tiles on the home page link to the gallery, and could the indicated stock photos be replaced with the supplied photos? I’d also like the home-page image changed to a photo of a house. Apart from those requests, everything is looking good. Thank you!

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text:
The site looks great and seems nearly ready to go live. Aside from a few tweaks like text, which I can come up with, it appears close to completion.

Would it be possible to create a couple of places across the home page and gallery that link to video? Ideally, videos would be integrated with the portfolio as well. Is that something we could do?

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: For the gallery, integrating the videos alongside the pictures would be ideal. On the home screen, the video would work best beside the portfolio photos. Thanks!

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text:
We're only using this as a temporary placeholder video; you can access it here:

<https://files.silverpine-media.example/scl/fi/b8r3w6k1m9q4t7v2x5p0/Coastal-Aerial-Narration.mp4?dl=0>

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: Everything looks great. As the final change, could you remove the video from the home page while leaving it on the Gallery? I should not have any further revisions after that, and we should then be ready to go live. Thank you so much for all your help!

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text:
Let's go ahead with the additional page at the offered price—thank you very much. Please make it a quote page and leave out Calendly for now, since I currently schedule appointments through Google Calendar. I may switch to a dedicated scheduling tool later when our volume increases.

Could the form collect Name, Company (optional), Phone Number, Email, and Job Description? Also, would you be able to style it according to the current brand guidelines?
